asset_set: Questionnaire Q13 option 2 — Researching quantum computing

art_style.fill_technique: solid flat fills with optional 8–12% ambient shade on curved surfaces only

art_style.mood: quiet deep-focus research energy — approachable science curiosity, not a sterile lab horror scene
reference_vibe: KursoKo approved RIASEC sticker line weight
art_style.match_family: Same 2px ink and flat fill language as RIASEC stickers — but NO letter glyph and NO colored border frame
forbidden: die-cut sticker border or white card frame
readable text, real equations, or numbers

accent.name: deep violet
accent.use: qubit lattice nodes, lab-coat cuff trim

color.background: fully transparent — no floor plane, no vignette, no cream fill behind scene
color.lighting_tint: faint warm #FFF8F0 highlight on knuckle tops only

left_hand.grip: pencil held in a relaxed writing grip

right_hand.action: points at a highlighted node on the qubit lattice diagram

right_hand.position: center-right, hovering near the monitor edge

pose.gesture_summary: mid-thought freeze frame — connecting a diagram idea to a notebook sketch
pose.framing: crop at mid-forearm — no elbows, no face, no torso

accessories.placement: folded at desk edge, not worn

subject.scene_narrative: A pair of forearms works at a quiet physics desk, one hand sketching a simple symbol in a notebook while the other points at a glowing node on a monitor's qubit lattice diagram. Folded safety glasses rest nearby. The scene reads as deep theoretical curiosity — a mind chasing a connection, not a sterile clinical lab.

primary_objects.name: monitor with qubit lattice diagram
primary_objects.detail: grid of connected violet nodes joined by thin teal lines, no readable labels

primary_objects.name: open notebook
primary_objects.detail: faint sketch of simple geometric symbols, no real equations or text

primary_objects.name: folded safety glasses
primary_objects.detail: resting closed at the desk edge

subject.environment: light physics desk surface strip across bottom third — fades to transparent at edges
